limitations: Only the four assigned current originals and one assigned source original were opened. No old candidate, contact sheet, additional case image or crop was used.
All four supplemental states use one related original queue contract; no independent exact-state reference or resized substitute was manufactured.

Actions, provider requests, queue projection, terminal downloads diagnostics, metadata and capture identities were read from existing saved evidence. No application, test, build, probe, validator, hash, SQL or SSH command was run.

The resume capture projection and terminal downloads diagnostics show different progress points. This report keeps those fields separate and does not infer continuing execution, precise transition timing, performance or physical input from a screenshot.
Cancellation retains completed/cancelled entries and a queue count of five. No actual empty-queue state was assigned, so empty-state feedback is not qualified.
No historical finding was assigned to this batch; the empty historical and regression arrays are separate from current suggestions.
